collectibles.description: The Aura Pokémon. A Pokémon that can sense and control auras of all things.

themes.name: Retro 90s
themes.description: Neon-soaked nostalgia from the 1990s. Vibrant colors, bold gradients, and that unmistakable retro vibe. Perfect for video enthusiasts who remember the glory days of CRT monitors and VHS.

themes.name: Wood Panel
themes.description: Brings the warm, natural aesthetic of wood paneling to your video library. Inspired by retro home entertainment systems with beautiful wood grain textures and warm tones.
